correctness.rationale: Full proof reduces the concrete S5 integral homology module equivariantly to the bipartite graph cycle lattice. Python standard-library verifier independently reconstructs 15 graph vertices, 180 simplices, no 4cycles, connected double cover, all fundamental cycles, unimodular Smith reduction of a 31x62 presentation (29 ones and two twos), and all 120 direct signed Lefschetz traces. Acyclic Morse reduction provides an additional nonequivariant homotopy check. No infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The symmetric Petersen graph is a canonical highly structured test case for natural graph-complex equivariance. Its 31-dimensional free homology lattice has no trivial rational summand but two independent order-two coinvariants, revealing precise integral symmetry obstructions invisible to ordinary homotopy type and to the rational character alone. The object and exact invariant are naturally motivated, without claiming a larger theorem.
